footer.footerDescp: A next-generation workflow and real-time tracking system for architecture.

faqContainer.q1: How does your pricing model work?
faqContainer.a1: There is no fixed subscription fee in Cadance Flow. A completely customized quote is generated for you based on the scale of your project, the number of renders, and animation requirements.
faqContainer.q2: Is there a limit on revisions during the design process?
faqContainer.a2: As a standard, you have 2 revision rights in each project; however, this can be increased upon request and depending on the project scale.
faqContainer.q3: Are our data and architectural projects safe?
faqContainer.a3: Absolutely. All technical drawings and intermediate renders you upload are protected with industry-standard encryption methods and are never shared with third parties without your explicit permission.
faqContainer.q4: When and how is the project tracking number (Track ID) delivered?
faqContainer.a4: After we finalize the project details together, a customized Track ID is automatically generated by the system and sent to your registered email address. With this code, you can immediately join the flow without needing to create a password.
faqContainer.q5: Can I track multiple projects simultaneously from a single account?
faqContainer.a5: Yes. If you log in with a corporate membership, you can manage all your active and archived projects smoothly from a single panel under the 'Current Projects' section on the dashboard.
faqContainer.q6: How much does the delivery time extend for urgent revisions during the render process?
faqContainer.a6: The biggest advantage of Cadance Flow is real-time feedback. The moment you leave a note on an image, a notification drops directly to our architect. Minor revisions (color, material changes, etc.) are processed on the same day and barely affect the final delivery time.
faqContainer.q7: Can I access past data and renders after the project is delivered?
faqContainer.a7: Yes. All your completed projects are automatically moved to the 'Archive' section. Depending on the scope of your contract, your final outputs and revision history are securely stored on our cloud servers for 12 months and can be downloaded again at any time.
